season.evidence: Logged successful ascents: Jul 53, Aug 58, Sep 41, Jun 10, Oct 6. Web guide: the south gully is snow-filled before July, basin snow lingers into August, no water past Easy Pass unless snow remains, road open roughly late April to early November. Stored Jul-Sep kept.

track.why: Sole route on the peak in our catalog. Round trip from the Easy Pass trailhead (start and end within 20 m of our pin), reaches Katsuk's summit within 4 m, highest point is Katsuk itself (not Mesahchie), 19 Sep. The report describes the Easy Pass traverse, the 8,200 ft gully crux, the notch and rib crossing then ledges to the summit block, which is our standard south-face line.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Sep 12 round trip from the trailhead but also summits Mesahchie (highest point about 600 m from our summit): two peaks in one track.
Aug 28 round trip that also reaches Mesahchie (highest point about 620 m away): two peaks.
Sep 20 report is a Kitling-Cub-Mesahchie east ridge outing; track also tops Mesahchie.
Jul 12 round trip but includes Mesahchie (highest point about 590 m away).
Oct 20 and the track ends 1.3 km from the trailhead; also includes Mesahchie.
Part of a multi-night Ragged Ridge traverse; camp-based and multi-peak.
High traverse with a night out, camp-based and includes Mesahchie.

facts.text: Reports from July and September mention a rappel station at the head of the upper gully and a sling with a ring on the west summit block; a short rope makes the class 4 downclimbs less committing, but the standard line remains a walk-off.
In mid-September the waterfall near 6,500 ft is the last running water on the way in; above it expect only a small murky pond in the basin and a leftover snow patch at the col, so fill up there.
In mid-July some steep snow still sat below the summit block; one party avoided it by climbing straight to the ridge and scrambling around the first false summit.

notes: Existing text says no rappel anchors exist on the Southwest Gully route; two independent reports (Jul and Sep) describe a rap station at the top of the gully and a sling and ring on the west summit, so that sentence is probably out of date. The Easy Pass Trailhead pin (48.5879,-120.8029) agrees with round-trip tracks within 35 m.
